cases.title: An invoice without a due date is aged from its customer's credit term
cases.marker: AUTOMATION: HOLD - an invoice without a due date cannot be made through the app
cases.plain: BLOCKED (held case): an invoice with no due date cannot be made through the app on QA - the invoice create call always computes the due date from the customer's credit term. Needs a developer data fix.
cases.observed_qa: Precondition cannot be set up on QA: an invoice with no due date. Rungs tried: (1) the front end's invoice create call (POST /api/invoices/create) - its due date is always computed as the invoice date plus the customer's credit term (InvoiceBuilder::getDueDate at 8e35ee0d02), the request's due_date is not used; (2) no edit call for an invoice's due date exists in app/src/api/billing; (3) the case itself is HELD for this reason (needs a developer data fix). What needs to be done: a developer stores one open invoice with an empty due date on QA, then run this case.

cases.title: A/P: a bill with no due date is not listed
cases.plain: BLOCKED: a bill without a due date cannot be made - a new vendor needs a payment term, and even a COD bill gets a due date (= its date). Needs a developer data fix.
cases.observed_qa: Precondition cannot be set up: a received bill with NO due date. Rungs tried: (1) receiving a purchase order through the front end's own call (POST /api/inventory/orders/accept) for a vendor on COD - the bill still gets a due date (= its invoice date; bill ZZT-P26-BILL, due Nov 06 2026); (2) a vendor with no payment terms cannot be saved - add-vendor answers 400 "credit_term: Missing required parameter"; (3) the code (CreateTransactionWhenDeliveryIsCreated at 8e35ee0d02) only blanks the due date when CreditTerms::getDueDate returns the very same object, which it never does (it always builds a new one), so no new bill can lack a due date. What needs to be done: a developer stores one unpaid bill with an empty due date on QA, then run this case.

cases.title: A/P: an overpaid bill is still listed with a negative balance
cases.plain: BLOCKED: the app refuses to overpay a bill ('Vendor transaction cannot be overpaid.'), so a $100 bill paid $110 cannot be set up. Needs a developer data fix or an existing overpaid bill.
cases.observed_qa: Precondition cannot be set up: a bill paid MORE than its amount. Rung tried: the vendor payment call the front end makes (POST /api/parts-catalogue/vendor/payment/create) paying $110.00 on the $100.00 bill ZZT-P27-BILL answers 400 "Vendor transaction cannot be overpaid." The screen's payment dialog uses the same call. What needs to be done: a developer stores one overpaid bill on QA (or names an existing one), then run this case.
